from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,collections,re
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.work/workload-profile-20261116';instrumented=out/'bin/sigma.exe';baseline=root/'zig-out/bin/sigma.exe';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report={'scope':json.loads((out/'scope.json').read_text()),'binaries':{'baseline':sha(baseline),'instrumented':sha(instrumented)},'cases':[]}
def invoke(name,args,profile):
 cmd=[str(instrumented if profile else baseline),*(['--profile'] if profile else []),*args]
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=240)
 (out/(name+'.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout);(out/(name+'.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
 assert p.returncode==0,(name,p.returncode,p.stdout[-300:],p.stderr[-300:])
 ops=[];total=0
 if profile:
  text=p.stderr.decode('utf-8');total=int(re.search(r'PROFILE: (\d+) OPERATIONS',text).group(1))
  for line in text.splitlines():
   if line.startswith('MEASURE-OP '):
    _,pc,count,kind,builtin=line.split();ops.append({'pc':int(pc),'count':int(count),'kind':kind,'builtin':builtin})
  assert sum(x['count'] for x in ops)==total,(name,total)
 return {'command':cmd,'stdout':p.stdout.decode('utf-8'),'total':total,'ops':ops}
# Known compiled calls prove target labels and reset/export conservation.
setup=': PROFILE-PROBE 11 22 2>R 2R@ 2DROP 2R> 2DROP 1. DNEGATE 2DROP 1 2 3 -ROT DROP DROP DROP ; : WORKLOAD 10 0 DO PROFILE-PROBE LOOP ;'
probe=invoke('probe',['-e',setup,'--measure-profile-reset','-e','WORKLOAD DEPTH . BYE'],True)
c=collections.Counter();
for x in probe['ops']:c[x['builtin']]+=x['count']
for key in ['two_r_fetch','two_r_from','d_negate','minus_rot']:assert c[key]==10,(key,c[key])
assert probe['stdout'].split()==['0'];report['probe']=probe
for case in json.loads((out/'cases.json').read_text()):
 args=['-e','0 CONSTANT NO-AUTORUN 0 CONSTANT NO-SOUND',str(root/case['file']),'-e',case['setup'],'-e',case['definition']]
 base=invoke(case['name']+'-baseline',args+['-e',case['finish']],False)
 ps=[invoke(case['name']+f'-profile-{i}',args+['--measure-profile-reset','-e',case['finish']],True) for i in [1,2]]
 assert all(p['stdout']==base['stdout'] for p in ps),(case['name'],base['stdout'],[p['stdout'] for p in ps]);assert ps[0]['ops']==ps[1]['ops'],case['name']
 kinds=collections.Counter();builtins=collections.Counter()
 for x in ps[0]['ops']:
  kinds[x['kind']]+=x['count']
  if x['builtin']!='-':builtins[x['builtin']]+=x['count']
  elif x['kind'] in ['dup','drop','swap','over','rot','nip','tuck','two_dup','two_drop','add','sub','mul','equal','not_equal','less','greater','zero_equal','zero_less','bit_and','bit_or','bit_xor','bit_complement','negate','one_plus','one_minus','to_r','from_r','r_fetch','fetch','store','cfetch','cstore','add_store','index','index_2','cells','cell_plus','two_star','two_slash','lshift','rshift','f_add','f_sub','f_mul','f_div','f_dup','f_drop','f_swap','f_over','execute']:builtins[x['kind']]+=x['count']
 row={'case':case,'source_sha256':sha(root/case['file']),'baseline':base,'profiles':ps,'kind_counts':dict(kinds.most_common()),'compiled_builtin_site_counts':dict(builtins.most_common())};report['cases'].append(row);(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(case['name'],ps[0]['total'],{k:builtins[k] for k in ['two_r_fetch','two_r_from','d_negate','minus_rot']},flush=True)
(out/'complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cases':len(report['cases']),'checks':'baseline stdout parity, repeated compiled-op counts, reset/export probe'})+'\n')
